description: Add book-style PDF viewer with manual table region selection and review workflow

workflow.1-Analyze: Read existing code and understand the context
workflow.2-Plan: Design the solution within existing architecture
workflow.4-Test: Verify it works manually or with tests

userStories.title: Add TableSelection model
userStories.description: Create model to store table region selections (auto-detected or manual) with approval status
acceptanceCriteria: File api/models.py contains TableSelection model
Fields: report (FK with CASCADE delete), page_num (PositiveIntegerField)
Fields: x1, y1, x2, y2 (FloatFields for PDF coords, bottom-left origin)
Fields: confidence (nullable FloatField for YOLO confidence)
Fields: source (CharField with choices: 'yolo', 'manual')
Fields: status (CharField with choices: 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected', 'failed')
Fields: created_at (DateTimeField auto_now_add)
Migration created and applied successfully
Existing data unaffected

userStories.title: Add extraction_mode and extraction_status to Report model
userStories.description: Add fields to track which extraction workflow the user chose and current processing state
acceptanceCriteria: Report model has extraction_mode field with choices: 'auto', 'manual', 'review'
Default extraction_mode is 'auto'
Report model has extraction_status field with choices: 'uploaded', 'detecting', 'pending_review', 'extracting', 'completed', 'failed'
Default extraction_status is 'uploaded'
Migration created and applied successfully
Existing reports get extraction_mode='auto' and extraction_status='completed'

userStories.title: Create TableSelectionSerializer
userStories.description: Add serializer for TableSelection model CRUD operations with proper validation
acceptanceCriteria: TableSelectionSerializer in api/serializers.py
Includes fields: id, report, page_num, x1, y1, x2, y2, confidence, source, status, created_at
report field is read-only (set from URL in view)
Validates all coordinates are non-negative floats
Validates x1 < x2 and y1 < y2 (proper box orientation)
Validates page_num is within report's total_pages
source defaults to 'manual' if not provided
status defaults to 'approved' for manual source, 'pending' for yolo source

userStories.title: Add PDF metadata API endpoint
userStories.description: Create endpoint to get PDF page count and dimensions for viewer initialization
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/reports/{id}/metadata/ endpoint exists
Returns JSON: {total_pages, pages: [{page_num, width, height, rotation}, ...]}
Uses PyMuPDF (fitz) to read page dimensions and rotation
Handles rotated pages correctly (swap width/height for 90/270 rotation)
Only accessible by report owner (IsReportOwner permission)
Returns 404 for invalid report ID
reviewQuestions: Check how existing code uses fitz/PyMuPDF
Consider caching metadata to avoid repeated PDF reads

userStories.title: Add TableSelection CRUD API endpoints
userStories.description: Create endpoints for listing, creating, updating, and deleting table selections
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/reports/{id}/selections/ lists selections for report
GET supports optional ?page_num= query param to filter by page
GET supports optional ?status= query param to filter by status (comma-separated, e.g., ?status=pending,approved)
POST /api/reports/{id}/selections/ creates new selection (sets report from URL)
PATCH /api/reports/{id}/selections/{sel_id}/ updates status field only
DELETE /api/reports/{id}/selections/{sel_id}/ removes selection
All endpoints require authentication and report ownership
Returns 404 if selection doesn't belong to the report

userStories.title: Create standalone YOLO detection function
userStories.description: Refactor YOLO detection to return bounding boxes without extracting tables
acceptanceCriteria: New function in api/scripts/YOLOV3/predict_table.py: detect_table_regions(file_path, page_number)
Returns list of dicts: [{x1, y1, x2, y2, confidence}, ...]
Coordinates in PDF space (bottom-left origin)
Reuses existing YOLO inference code (detectTable, outpout_yolo, bboxes_pdf)
Does NOT call Camelot or save to database
Cleans up temporary image files
Unit test verifies it returns bounding boxes for a test PDF
Coordinates computed using bboxes_pdf() which applies Y-flip: y = (1 - y_norm) * H_pdf
reviewQuestions: Look at existing detect_tables() function structure
Reuse norm_bbox() and bboxes_pdf() for coordinate conversion
Reference bboxes_pdf() at predict_table.py:152-172 for the Y-flip math

userStories.title: Add detect-for-review Celery task
userStories.description: Create task that runs YOLO detection and saves boxes as TableSelection records
acceptanceCriteria: New Celery task: detect_tables_for_review(report_id) in api/tasks.py
Updates Report.extraction_status to 'detecting' at start
Calls detect_table_regions() for each page in range
Saves detected boxes as TableSelection(source='yolo', status='pending')
Updates Report.extraction_status to 'pending_review' on success
Updates Report.extraction_status to 'failed' on error
Returns {status, report_id, selections_count, redirect_url} for frontend

userStories.title: Add extract-from-selections Celery task and endpoint
userStories.description: Create task and API endpoint to extract tables using approved selections
acceptanceCriteria: New Celery task: extract_from_selections(report_id) in api/tasks.py
Gets TableSelection records where status='approved' (includes both YOLO-approved and manual selections, since manual is auto-approved per BV-003)
Groups selections by page_num
Builds table_areas list as [(x1, y1, x2, y2), ...] for each page
table_areas coordinates in PDF space (bottom-left origin, same format as stored in TableSelection)
Calls MultiExtractor.extract_best(pdf_path, page, table_areas=[...])
Saves results to Extracted model
Updates Report.extraction_status to 'completed'
POST /api/reports/{id}/extract-selections/ endpoint triggers this task
Endpoint returns {task_id, status} for polling
reviewQuestions: Look at api/scripts/extractors/multi_extractor.py for extract_best() signature
Look at existing extract_tables_async_task for save pattern
Use existing TaskStatusView at /task-status/<task_id>/ for polling extraction status

userStories.title: Add book viewer Django view and URL
userStories.description: Create the view that renders the book viewer template
acceptanceCriteria: BookViewerView class in api/views.py (LoginRequiredMixin, View)
URL pattern: /reports/<int:pk>/viewer/ maps to BookViewerView
Verifies report ownership (returns 403 if not owner)
Passes report object and CSRF token to template context
Returns 404 for invalid report ID

userStories.title: Create book viewer template
userStories.description: Create the main HTML template for the book-style PDF viewer
acceptanceCriteria: New file: templates/reports/viewer.html extends base.html
Includes PDF.js via CDN (version 4.x, ES module)
Has two-page spread layout with left and right page containers
Has navigation controls (prev/next spread buttons)
Has mode toggle between 'View' and 'Select Tables'
Has zoom controls (+/- buttons with percentage display)
Shows page numbers below each page
Includes selection panel at bottom showing current selections with count
Shows loading spinner while PDF loads
Shows error message if PDF fails to load
Includes CSRF token in meta tag for JS access

userStories.title: Create book viewer Alpine.js component
userStories.description: Implement the PDF rendering and navigation logic
acceptanceCriteria: New file: static/js/book-viewer.js
Alpine.js component that loads PDF with PDF.js
Renders two pages side-by-side (spread layout)
currentSpread state (0 = pages 1-2, 1 = pages 3-4, etc.)
Handles single-page PDFs and odd page counts gracefully
Prev/next navigation updates spread and re-renders
Page number input field allows direct navigation to specific page (validates 1 to totalPages)
Stores PDF page dimensions in canvas.dataset for coordinate conversion
Zoom controls scale the viewport (0.5x to 2.0x range)
Shows loading state during page render
Handles render errors gracefully with user feedback
reviewQuestions: PDF.js 4.x uses ES modules - ensure proper import pattern
Consider lazy loading for large PDFs (only render visible pages)

userStories.title: Create bounding box manager component
userStories.description: Implement canvas overlay for displaying and drawing table selections
acceptanceCriteria: New file: static/js/bbox-manager.js
Overlay canvas positioned absolutely on top of each PDF page canvas
Loads existing selections from API on page render
Color-codes boxes: orange (YOLO pending), green (approved), blue (manual)
Mouse events for drawing new boxes (mousedown, mousemove, mouseup)
Ignores boxes smaller than 20x20 canvas pixels (accidental clicks)
Click existing box to select it (highlight + show controls)
Coordinate conversion: canvasToPdf() and pdfToCanvas() functions
canvasToPdf() applies Y-axis flip: pdf_y = page_height - canvas_y (PDF uses bottom-left origin, canvas uses top-left)
pdfToCanvas() applies inverse Y-axis flip: canvas_y = page_height - pdf_y
After drawing, shows confirm/cancel buttons before saving to API (allows undo before commit)
Pressing Escape or clicking cancel removes the pending box without API call
Saves new selections to API on confirm with CSRF token
Shows error toast if API save fails with retry option
reviewQuestions: Reference api/scripts/YOLOV3/predict_table.py:152 bboxes_pdf() for transformation math
Get CSRF token from meta tag: document.querySelector('meta[name=csrf-token]').content

userStories.title: Add review controls for YOLO detections
userStories.description: Show approve/reject buttons on YOLO-detected boxes in the viewer
acceptanceCriteria: YOLO boxes (source='yolo', status='pending') show approve (checkmark) and reject (X) icons
Icons appear on hover or when box is selected
Clicking approve calls PATCH API to set status='approved'
Clicking reject calls PATCH API to set status='rejected'
Rejected boxes fade out or show with reduced opacity
Box color updates immediately on status change
Includes CSRF token in PATCH requests
Shows error feedback if API call fails

userStories.title: Add extract button and extraction flow to viewer
userStories.description: Add button in viewer to trigger extraction of approved/manual selections
acceptanceCriteria: Extract Selected Tables button visible in selection panel
Button shows count of approved selections (manual selections are auto-approved per BV-003)
Button disabled if count is 0
Clicking triggers POST to /api/reports/{id}/extract-selections/
Shows loading state with progress indicator during extraction
Polls task status endpoint until complete
Redirects to report detail page on success
Shows error message on failure with retry option

userStories.title: Add extraction mode selector to upload page
userStories.description: Let users choose extraction workflow at upload time
acceptanceCriteria: Radio buttons on upload.html: Automatic (default), Auto + Review, Manual Selection
Brief description under each option explaining the workflow
Selection saved to Report.extraction_mode on upload
Automatic: existing flow - extract immediately, redirect to results
Auto + Review: triggers detect_tables_for_review task, polls status, redirects to viewer when 'pending_review'
Manual: sets extraction_status='pending_review', redirects directly to viewer
Progress indicator shown during detection phase for Auto + Review

userStories.title: Add Open Viewer link to report detail page
userStories.description: Allow users to access viewer from existing report detail page
acceptanceCriteria: Link/button on reports/detail.html: 'Open Book Viewer'
Styled consistently with other action buttons
Links to /reports/{id}/viewer/
Visible for all reports regardless of extraction_mode

acceptanceCriteria: Upload PDF with 'Manual Selection' mode
Verify extraction_mode='manual' and extraction_status='pending_review' in DB

userStories.title: End-to-end test: Auto + Review flow
userStories.description: Verify the complete auto-detection with review workflow
acceptanceCriteria: Upload PDF with 'Auto + Review' mode
Verify YOLO detection task starts (check Celery logs or task status)
Verify extraction_status transitions: 'detecting' -> 'pending_review'
Redirected to viewer with detected boxes shown in orange
Approve some boxes (turn green), reject others (fade out)

Click Extract

userStories.title: End-to-end test: Edge cases
userStories.description: Verify handling of edge cases and error conditions
acceptanceCriteria: Single-page PDF displays correctly (no empty right page)
Large PDF (20+ pages) loads without browser freeze
Invalid PDF shows error message in viewer
Network error during save shows retry option
Navigating away with unsaved changes shows warning (if applicable)
Zooming preserves box positions correctly

userStories.title: Handle edge cases in detection and extraction
userStories.description: Gracefully handle zero YOLO detections, partial extraction failures, and network errors
acceptanceCriteria: If YOLO detects 0 tables on all pages, show message: 'No tables detected. Draw selections manually or try a different PDF.'
Viewer still opens normally with empty overlay when 0 detections
If extraction fails for some selections but succeeds for others, report partial success with list of failed pages
Failed selections are marked with status='failed' (uses status choice added in BV-001)
Network error during box save shows inline retry button on the failed box
Network error during extraction shows retry button with error message
All error messages are user-friendly (no raw exception text)
